title: bouch-game-assets
summary: Evidence-led game and 3D asset production. Consult whenever an agent builds, imports, repairs, verifies, playtests or visually reviews a game-ready asset or scene. Separates source, import, deterministic runtime, real interaction and perceptual evidence; preserves immutable candidates and bounded repair lineage; closes out only on persisted evidence. Projects still own their engine/DCC adapters and runtime harnesses.

source.note: Initial package is being prepared in the plugin marketplace repository; pin a release ref before promoting this record to active.
